dossier_meta.statement_text: Every planar graph has fractional vertex-arboricity at most two.
dossier_meta.context_text: This is the fractional generalization of the Albertson-Berman Conjecture: since $|V(G)|/a(G) \leq \mathrm{va}_f(G)$, the conjecture implies $a(G) \geq |V(G)|/2$. If true, it would also imply that every planar graph has fractional chromatic number at most four.
